hunks.baseline: It was like trying to find a squirrel hiding in a dense forest. You simply couldn’t spot it easily.
hunks.sol: It was like trying to find a squirrel hidden in a dense forest.

hunks.baseline: The Mutated Water God Dragon’s body was truly enormous, and I had never imagined that a weakness could exist in a part of its body that it had protected so thoroughly throughout the battle.
hunks.sol: The Mutated Water God Dragon’s body was simply too enormous for me to spot it, and I had never imagined there could be such a gap in a part of its body it had guarded so thoroughly throughout the battle.

hunks.baseline: A weakness capable of severing the windpipe of this gigantic monster.
hunks.sol: A weakness that could end this gigantic monster’s stubborn life.

hunks.baseline: And I did not let the perfect opportunity to end this fight slip away.
hunks.sol: And I did not let the perfect opportunity to finish the fight slip away.

hunks.baseline: Living creatures were truly strange. They constantly evolved, compensating for their weaknesses to suit the environments around them.
hunks.sol: Living creatures were truly remarkable. They constantly evolved, adapting to their surroundings and compensating for their weaknesses.

hunks.baseline: If even humans, with their life expectancy of barely a hundred years, did that, then surely this sublime being, which had lived for hundreds of years, would be no different.
hunks.sol: If even humans, whose average life span was only now approaching a hundred years, could do that, then surely this exalted being, which had lived for centuries, was no different.

hunks.baseline: The most important fact at this moment was that there had been exactly enough space for one scale to be missing at the back of the monster’s neck, which was covered in its strongest scales.
hunks.sol: The only thing that mattered now was that a gap exactly one scale wide had been left in the monster’s neck, which was otherwise covered in its toughest scales.

hunks.baseline: And I hadn’t missed that gap.
hunks.sol: And I hadn’t missed it.

hunks.baseline: Those final words of encouragement were a privilege only the victor could enjoy.
hunks.sol: Those final words were a privilege reserved for the victor.

hunks.baseline: I had driven my spearhead precisely into the area beneath its neck—where a human’s Adam’s apple would have been—and tightened my grip around the shaft as I shoved it deeper.
hunks.sol: I had driven my spearhead precisely into the underside of its neck—where a human’s Adam’s apple would have been. Tightening my grip on the shaft, I shoved it deeper.

hunks.baseline: The dragon’s scaled jaw trembled, accompanied by a short groan like it was sucking in a breath that would never come.
hunks.sol: The dragon’s scaled jaw trembled with a short groan, as though it were trying and failing to draw breath.

hunks.baseline: Then its jet-black pupil shook, and the sphere of water that had nearly finished forming at the back of its wide-open maw began to scatter.
hunks.sol: Then its jet-black pupil quivered, and the sphere of water on the verge of completion inside its wide-open maw began to disperse.

hunks.baseline: The incomplete Water Breath was nothing more than ordinary water.
hunks.sol: An incomplete Water Breath was nothing more than ordinary water.

hunks.baseline: I did not dodge the deluge pouring down toward the crown of my head. I took it all head-on.
hunks.sol: I did not avoid the deluge pouring down over my head. I let it hit me full-on.

hunks.baseline: The unusually cold waters of Dongting Lake soaked me from head to toe, and my mind settled into calm.
hunks.sol: The unusually cold water of Dongting Lake soaked me from head to toe, calming my mind.

hunks.baseline: At the same time, a thrilling sensation surged up my spine.
hunks.sol: At the same time, a thrill surged up my spine.

hunks.baseline: The end of a long and fierce battle.
hunks.sol: The end of a long, brutal battle.

hunks.baseline: I had survived once again and driven a spearhead into the neck of a powerful foe. And as always, the end of a life-or-death battle could be reduced to two words.
hunks.sol: Once again, I had survived and buried my spearhead in the neck of a powerful enemy. And as always, the end of a life-or-death battle came down to two words.

hunks.baseline: The victor standing tall and the loser collapsing.
hunks.sol: The victor standing tall and the loser lying fallen.

hunks.baseline: Even an evil beast that had lived for an immeasurably long time could not be exempt from this absolute law of the jungle.
hunks.sol: Even an evil beast that had lived for an unfathomable span of time was no exception to that absolute law of the jungle.

hunks.baseline: The body that had once held unparalleled resilience and power gave way, then fell onto the waters of Dongting Lake.
hunks.sol: The body that had once possessed such immense strength and resilience gave way and toppled onto the waters of Dongting Lake.

hunks.baseline: Through the spray rising high into the air, I saw an eye blinking slowly and a snout trembling faintly.
hunks.sol: Through the spray rising high into the air, I saw its eye blink slowly and its snout tremble faintly.

hunks.baseline: —You’re exactly the same.
hunks.sol: —You are just as I remember.

hunks.baseline: The moment I heard someone’s voice echo inside my head, the strength left my hand, which had been about to drive the spear in once more and finish severing the dragon’s windpipe.
hunks.sol: The moment someone’s voice echoed inside my head, the strength drained from the hand that had been about to drive the spear in again and finish the job.

hunks.baseline: As I stared at the enormous eye of the Mutated Water God Dragon as though bewitched, I felt my body suddenly stiffen.
hunks.sol: As though bewitched, I stared into the Mutated Water God Dragon’s enormous eye and felt my body lock in place.

hunks.baseline: The monster’s appearance, gleaming entirely in jet black and carrying an ominous murderous aura, could no longer be found anywhere.
hunks.sol: The jet-black gleam and murderous aura that had made it look like a monster born beneath an ill-fated star were nowhere to be found.

hunks.baseline: Like storm clouds clearing after a day of pouring rain, clear and deep eyes resembling the blue sky were now looking at me.
hunks.sol: Like dark clouds parting after a day of driving rain, an eye as clear and deep as the blue sky gazed back at me.

hunks.baseline: —There is no need to be surprised. After living for around five hundred years, one naturally acquires abilities like this.
hunks.sol: —There is no need to be surprised. After five hundred years or so, one naturally acquires abilities like this.

hunks.baseline: —Perhaps it would be more accurate to call it mental intent.
hunks.sol: —Perhaps it would be more accurate to call it a transmission of thought.

hunks.baseline: The Mutated Water God Dragon—or rather, this divine being also known by another name, the Two-Horned Beast of Dongting Lake—calmly sent its thoughts to me.
hunks.sol: The Mutated Water God Dragon—or rather, the divine being also known as the Two-Horned Beast of Dongting Lake—calmly sent its thoughts into my mind.

hunks.baseline: —You do not know me, but I know you. You look exactly as you did when I saw you in a dream long ago. I had forgotten it, thinking it was nothing more than a confused dream… Yes. This, too, must be the natural order.
hunks.sol: —You do not know me, but I know you. You look exactly as you did when I saw you in a dream long ago. I dismissed it as an idle dream and forgot all about it… Yes. This, too, must be part of the natural order.

hunks.baseline: —Huh.
hunks.sol: —Hah.

hunks.baseline: My hesitation, as I searched for something to say, must have looked rather amusing. A growling laugh escaped the blood-soaked corner of the Water God Dragon’s mouth.
hunks.sol: My fumbling for words must have struck it as amusing. A growling laugh rumbled from the blood-soaked corner of the Water God Dragon’s mouth.

hunks.baseline: —You can neither understand it nor should you try. It is nothing more than the grumbling of an old imugi that failed to ascend because its cultivation was lacking. If there is one thing I regret, it is that I have no time left.
hunks.sol: —You cannot understand, so do not try. These are merely the ramblings of an old imugi whose cultivation proved insufficient to ascend. My only regret is that I have no time left.

hunks.baseline: The Water God Dragon’s words were true. Its body had already reached its limit and stood on the verge of death, while the light was gradually fading from its deep eyes.
hunks.sol: The Water God Dragon was right. Its body had already reached its limit and stood on the verge of death. The light was slowly fading from its deep eye.

hunks.baseline: Even if I regretted it now, the water had already been spilled.
hunks.sol: It was too late for regrets.

hunks.baseline: I bit down on my lip.
hunks.sol: I bit my lip.

hunks.baseline: I felt sorry about the Water God Dragon’s death. And to be perfectly honest, I also felt disappointed.
hunks.sol: Part of me mourned the Water God Dragon’s impending death. To be coldly honest, another part simply regretted the loss.

hunks.baseline: This mystical being had regained its senses moments before death. It was an important key to solving the mystery.
hunks.sol: This mystical being had regained its senses just before death. It could have been the key to unraveling the mystery.

hunks.baseline: There was no way that a divine and wise imugi had become a mad evil beast that slaughtered humans for no reason.
hunks.sol: There was no way a divine and wise imugi had turned into a mad evil beast that slaughtered humans for no reason.

hunks.baseline: Someone must have intervened. And if so, Dark Heaven—at the very top of the list of suspects behind every incident currently taking place in the Murim—could not be excluded.
hunks.sol: Someone must have interfered. And if so, I could hardly leave Dark Heaven off the list when it stood at the very top of the suspects behind everything currently happening in the Murim.

hunks.baseline: “Who did this, and how?”
hunks.sol: “Who did this to you? And how?”

hunks.baseline: It was a short question, but it contained everything.
hunks.sol: The question was brief, but it contained everything.

hunks.baseline: Yet the Water God Dragon’s mental reply that immediately followed went beyond anything I had expected.
hunks.sol: The Water God Dragon’s reply went far beyond anything I had expected.

hunks.baseline: In answer to my question, the Water God Dragon simply blinked.
hunks.sol: The Water God Dragon answered by blinking.

hunks.baseline: *Slither.*
hunks.sol: *Srrk.*

hunks.baseline: Blue liquid filled its enormous eye. The thing everyone called tears slowly slid down its scales. The moment it touched my body, I understood what the Water God Dragon had meant.
hunks.sol: Blue liquid welled in its enormous eye. The liquid everyone called tears slid slowly down its scales, and the moment it touched me, I understood what the Water God Dragon had meant.

hunks.baseline: Along with the System notification ringing in my ears, the Water God Dragon’s tear spread out like a curtain before my eyes.
hunks.sol: As the System notification rang in my ears, the Water God Dragon’s tear unfurled like a curtain before my eyes.

hunks.baseline: Along with the cool sensation of water, the world came to a stop.
hunks.sol: A cool sensation washed over me.
Then the world stopped.

hunks.baseline: The Water God Dragon’s five hundred years were contained within it in their entirety. But perhaps because of the effects of its mutation, some parts had broken away. Some memories were blurred, while others remained clear.
hunks.sol: It held the five hundred years the Water God Dragon had lived, but perhaps because of the mutation, parts of it had broken away. Some memories were blurred, while others remained perfectly clear.

hunks.baseline: And the beginning of it all was its birth.
hunks.sol: And everything began with its birth.

hunks.baseline: Somewhere deep beneath the waters of Dongting Lake, a tiny newborn creature looked around in confusion.
hunks.sol: Somewhere deep beneath the waters of Dongting Lake, a tiny newborn creature looked around in bewilderment.

hunks.baseline: It was surrounded by swaying aquatic plants that moved as though dancing and an uncountable number of underwater creatures.
hunks.sol: Aquatic plants swayed as though dancing, and countless underwater creatures had gathered around it.

hunks.baseline: That day was a joyous one—the day a new master of Dongting Lake was born, and the day a grand enthronement ceremony was held.
hunks.sol: It was an auspicious day—the birth of a new master of Dongting Lake and the occasion of a grand enthronement ceremony.

hunks.baseline: The new master of the river tilted its head with a curious expression like a puppy, then began swimming with its tiny body.
hunks.sol: The new master of the river tilted its head with all the curiosity of a puppy, then began to swim with its tiny body.

hunks.baseline: The moment a being born with dazzling wisdom and power began to move, countless creatures followed behind it, and even the river parted to make way.
hunks.sol: The moment this being, gifted with dazzling wisdom and power at birth, began to move, countless creatures followed behind it, and even the river parted to make way.

hunks.baseline: Its body, slicing through the waters of Dongting Lake with both flexibility and vigor, gradually grew larger.
hunks.sol: As it cut through the waters of Dongting Lake with supple, powerful movements, its body gradually grew larger.

hunks.baseline: Silver scales sprouted across its once-small, soft pink body, and imposing whiskers grew quite long beneath its snout.
hunks.sol: Silver scales sprouted across its once-small, soft pink body, and imposing whiskers grew long beneath its snout.

hunks.baseline: It was probably around then.
hunks.sol: It must have been around then.

hunks.baseline: People who witnessed the divine being appear once every few decades—or perhaps even longer—gave it a new name out of reverence.
hunks.sol: Those who caught sight of this divine being once every few decades—or even less often—gave it a new name out of reverence.

hunks.baseline: A name I knew as well.
hunks.sol: A name I knew well.

hunks.baseline: Perhaps because of the two horns on its forehead, it was also called the Two-Horned Beast. But most people were reluctant to call this beautiful and mysterious being a beast, instead worshiping it as the divine spirit of Dongting Lake.
hunks.sol: Perhaps because of the two horns on its forehead, it was also called the Two-Horned Beast. But most people were reluctant to call such a beautiful and mysterious being a mere beast. Instead, they worshiped it as the divine spirit of Dongting Lake.

hunks.baseline: And the imugi, having received a new name from humans, would occasionally perform acts that truly seemed divine.
hunks.sol: And the imugi, having received a new name from humanity, would occasionally perform deeds that truly seemed divine.

hunks.baseline: It would rescue sailors who had nearly drowned and carry them to remote shores untouched by people. It would also use its innate abilities to calm violent currents.
hunks.sol: It rescued sailors on the verge of drowning and carried them to remote stretches of dry land. It also used its innate power to calm violent currents on countless occasions.

hunks.baseline: And that wasn’t all. The one that defeated the evil beast that had once stained the Yangtze with blood was the Water God Dragon.
hunks.sol: And that wasn’t all. The Water God Dragon was also the one that defeated an evil beast that had once stained the Yangtze with blood.

hunks.baseline: After defeating the turtle-shaped evil beast in a fierce battle, the Water God Dragon came to rule Dongting Lake and the Yangtze.
hunks.sol: After a fierce battle, it slew the turtle-shaped evil beast and came to rule both Dongting Lake and the Yangtze.

hunks.baseline: After more than five hundred long years had passed, the Water God Dragon had grown beyond comparison with its former self.
hunks.sol: Over the course of more than five hundred years, the Water God Dragon grew beyond all comparison to what it had once been.

hunks.baseline: It was a benevolent imugi with tremendous strength and profound wisdom, as well as an excellent ruler who knew how to care for its people.
hunks.sol: It was a benevolent imugi possessed of tremendous power and profound wisdom, and an excellent ruler who cared for its subjects.

hunks.baseline: —Huh. Fighting never ends in the Lower Realm.
hunks.sol: —Hah. The fighting in the Lower Realm never ends.

hunks.baseline: The devastation it had witnessed throughout its long life was truly horrific.
hunks.sol: The horrors it had witnessed over its long life were truly appalling.

hunks.baseline: Humans constantly fought among themselves, and whenever they did, countless rivers of blood and corpses were scattered across the waters.
hunks.sol: Humans constantly fought among themselves, and each time they did, untold blood and corpses spilled into the river.

hunks.baseline: As two empires fell and wars continued, the Water God Dragon grew worried and weary.
hunks.sol: Two empires fell and war followed war. The Water God Dragon grew troubled and weary.

hunks.baseline: —I have already spent an immeasurably long time in the Lower Realm. When, exactly, will I be able to ascend?
hunks.sol: —I have already spent an unfathomable span of time in the Lower Realm. When will I finally be able to ascend?

hunks.baseline: Even when people worshiped it as the divine spirit of Dongting Lake and called it a dragon, the Water God Dragon’s true nature was still that of an imugi that had yet to become a dragon.
hunks.sol: No matter how people worshiped it as the divine spirit of Dongting Lake and called it a dragon, the Water God Dragon was, in truth, still an imugi that had yet to become one.

hunks.baseline: For the Water God Dragon, ascension was practically a goal set from the moment of its birth.
hunks.sol: For the Water God Dragon, ascension was practically a destiny determined at birth.

hunks.baseline: But its cultivation progressed so slowly that it came to resent the heavens, and enlightenment never seemed to arrive.
hunks.sol: But its cultivation progressed so slowly that it came to resent the heavens, and enlightenment remained stubbornly out of reach.

hunks.baseline: Then, news brought by a school of fish was enough to stir the curiosity of the weary Water God Dragon.
hunks.sol: Then a school of fish brought news that was more than enough to stir the weary Water God Dragon’s curiosity.

hunks.baseline: —You say a human has appeared? But no one has visited that place for the past several decades.
hunks.sol: —You say a human has appeared? But no one has visited that place in decades.

hunks.baseline: An uninvited visitor had entered the deepest, most secret, and most perilous region of Dongting Lake, a place no human had set foot in for a very long time.
hunks.sol: An uninvited visitor had entered the deepest and most secluded part of Dongting Lake—a treacherous place where no human had set foot in a very long time.

hunks.baseline: Suddenly curious, the Water God Dragon went to the place it had once used as its dwelling. The moment it arrived, it realized that something had gone terribly wrong.
hunks.sol: Its curiosity piqued, the Water God Dragon headed for the place it had once used as its dwelling.
The moment it arrived, it realized something was terribly wrong.

hunks.baseline: The Water God Dragon of the past was not the only one to be shocked.
hunks.sol: The Water God Dragon of the past was not the only one shocked by the sight.

hunks.baseline: I was the same, staring at the scene through the fragment of memory.
hunks.sol: Watching through the fragment of memory, I was just as stunned.

hunks.baseline: *That couldn’t be…*
hunks.sol: *That can’t be…*

hunks.baseline: Something sticky and unpleasant slowly crawled up my spine.
hunks.sol: A clammy, sickening sensation crept slowly up my spine.

hunks.baseline: Overcome by disbelief, doubt, and the shock of being struck in the back of the head, I muttered blankly.
hunks.sol: Overcome by disbelief, doubt, and the sheer shock of being blindsided, I muttered blankly.

hunks.baseline: Having passed through Gates hundreds, no, thousands of times by then, I was certain.
hunks.sol: I had passed through Gates hundreds—no, thousands—of times. I was certain.

hunks.baseline: The black energy pouring in steady streams through the cracks between the enormous rocks was unmistakably mana.
hunks.sol: The black energy pouring in streams through the cracks between the enormous rocks was unmistakably magical power.

hunks.baseline: My vision went dizzy, and every kind of profanity echoed inside my head.
hunks.sol: My vision swam, and every curse I knew echoed through my head.

hunks.baseline: If I had not been inside the Water God Dragon’s memories—if I had been able to speak aloud and move freely—I would have smashed everything around me. I would have screamed until my throat split open.
hunks.sol: If I had not been trapped inside the Water God Dragon’s memories—if I had been able to move and shout freely—I would have smashed everything around me. I would have screamed until my throat tore open.

hunks.baseline: *Fuck, a Gate. Mana!*
hunks.sol: *Fuck, a Gate. Magical power!*

hunks.baseline: My head felt as though it would burst from the countless thoughts racing through it. The shout I could not release scattered at the tip of my tongue.
hunks.sol: My head felt ready to burst from the flood of thoughts. The scream I could not release died on the tip of my tongue.

hunks.baseline: Eyes wide with shock and fury, I stared blankly at what was unfolding before me.
hunks.sol: Eyes wide with shock and fury, I stared at the scene unfolding before me.

hunks.baseline: The master of the lake used its entire body to block the countless subjects charging toward it.
hunks.sol: The master of the lake used its entire body to hold back the countless subjects charging toward it.

hunks.baseline: The teeth of the fish exposed to demonic qi were sharper than saw blades, and their scales had been dyed completely jet black.
hunks.sol: The teeth of the fish exposed to demonic qi were sharper than saw blades, and their scales had turned completely jet black.

hunks.baseline: But the desperate mental plea could not reach the fish already mutated by demonic qi, and the Water God Dragon was forced to make an extremely difficult decision.
hunks.sol: But its desperate thoughts could no longer reach the fish mutated by demonic qi, and the Water God Dragon was forced to make a terrible decision.

hunks.baseline: If those strangely powerful and violent fish escaped this place, all of Dongting Lake and the Yangtze would be stained with blood.
hunks.sol: If those unnaturally powerful and violent fish escaped, all of Dongting Lake and the Yangtze would be stained with blood.

hunks.baseline: A sacrifice was necessary for the greater good.
hunks.sol: A sacrifice had to be made for the greater good.

hunks.baseline: The battle that took place in the deepest waters of Dongting Lake ended, naturally, with the Water God Dragon’s victory.
hunks.sol: The battle in the deepest waters of Dongting Lake naturally ended in the Water God Dragon’s victory.

hunks.baseline: But the Water God Dragon was not even given time to grieve.
hunks.sol: But it was not even given time to grieve.

preferred glossary term appears in BASE but not SOL for this hunk

hunks.baseline: This wise imugi, which had lived for hundreds of years, understood what it had to do and used its own body to block the enormous rift that constantly poured out ominous energy.
hunks.sol: The wise imugi, which had lived for centuries, understood what it had to do. It placed its own body over the enormous rift that ceaselessly poured out its ominous energy.

hunks.baseline: —I do not know what you are, but things will not go as you wish.
hunks.sol: —I do not know what you are, but you will not have your way.

hunks.baseline: It was the longest and fiercest battle of the Water God Dragon’s entire life.
hunks.sol: It was the longest and fiercest struggle of the Water God Dragon’s entire life.

hunks.baseline: For seven days and nights, while their strength remained evenly matched, the waters of Dongting Lake and the Yangtze roiled violently, and the people on land grew afraid, believing that the divine spirit had grown angry.
hunks.sol: For seven days and nights, the two powers remained locked in a stalemate. The waters of Dongting Lake and the Yangtze churned violently, and the people on land trembled in fear, believing the divine spirit had grown angry.

hunks.baseline: And I already knew the outcome of that battle.
hunks.sol: And I already knew how that struggle ended.

hunks.baseline: The Water God Dragon had lost its dazzling intelligence and fallen into an evil beast. It let out a low growl.
hunks.sol: The Water God Dragon, its dazzling intelligence lost as it fell into corruption and became an evil beast, let out a low growl.

hunks.baseline: It had protected its territory and subjects by absorbing most of the demonic qi, but it could not withstand all that power.
hunks.sol: It had protected its territory and subjects by absorbing most of the demonic qi, but it could not contain all that power.

hunks.baseline: Both its eyes slowly turned red.
hunks.sol: Its eyes slowly turned red.

hunks.baseline: Yet the last grain of reason remaining inside it caused the Water God Dragon to surge out of the water.
hunks.sol: Yet its last remaining grain of reason drove the Water God Dragon to surge out of the water.

hunks.baseline: It was the will of an old imugi that wanted to find the culprit behind this terrible atrocity.
hunks.sol: It was the will of an old imugi determined to find the culprit behind this terrible atrocity.

hunks.baseline: The Water God Dragon rose as though ascending to heaven, and its red pupil reflected a person sitting on a moss-covered rock and splashing their feet in the water.
hunks.sol: The Water God Dragon rose as though ascending to heaven, and reflected in its red pupil was a person sitting on a moss-covered rock, kicking their feet idly through the water.

hunks.baseline: “The energy here is nice. Coming all this way was worth it.”
hunks.sol: “The energy here is lovely. Coming all this way was worth it.”

hunks.baseline: And a silver hairpin securing long black hair twisted up.
hunks.sol: And a silver hairpin securing long black hair twisted into a knot.

hunks.baseline: Along with the name of one person surfacing in my mind, the entire world surrounding me shattered into pieces.
hunks.sol: The moment that name surfaced in my mind, the entire world around me shattered into pieces.
